17
Commission for Truth, Unity and
Reconciliation in Sri Lanka
to  control,  supervise  and  administer  the  assets  of
the Commission;
to  seek  technical  assistance  from  any  person  or
institution  or  organisation  in  the  interest  of
advancement of the Commission’s work;
to  draw  on  the  work  of  other  bodies,  including
previous Commissions of Inquiry;
to  prioritize  proceedings  with  the  objective  of

promoting  national 
reconciliation,  peace,
co-existence and non-recurrence within the context
of this Act;
subject  to  subsection  (3)  of  section  7,  to  conduct
public sittings and when the Commission considers
it  possible  publicly  broadcast  or  telecast  its
proceedings either simultaneously or otherwise;
subject  to  subsection  (4)  of  section  7  to  conduct
closed  sittings  where  the  Commission  deems  it
necessary;
to create a complete database and to take steps to
maintain and to ensure the deposit and maintenance
of  all  material  collected  by  the  Commission  and
reports  of  the  Commission  in  such  database  and
thereafter  submit  the  same  to  the  Department  of
National Archives for the purpose of archiving;
to receive from any aggrieved persons complaints
or reports relating to the alleged damage or harm
caused  to  persons  or  property  referred  to  in
subsection (1) of section 12;
